name: notes
description: Éditeur de notes local-first avec synchronisation SMB

scripts.dev: npm run build:companion && npm run dev -w @notes/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:companion && npm run build -w @notes/desktop
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w @notes/desktop
scripts.test:companion: cd apps/smb-companion && go vet ./... && go test ./...
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w @notes/desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
